scope.existing_test_adjustment: Callable cases and operational count cases now each start with a fresh port/app so existing exact cold-owner-read assertions remain intact. The metrics test file is validated only; no edits.

design.approach: Single-flight plus a short process-local memo of validated bounded Registry summary pages; no memo of BFF responses, persona/ranking projection or full catalog.
design.failure_policy: Exceptions and malformed/forbidden owner payloads are never inserted into the cross-request memo. Concurrent waiters receive their in-flight outcome; the next independent request retries. Existing request-scoped owner-read semantics remain unchanged.
design.isolation: Each port owns its memo. Hits and joined results are deep-copied; leader results are detached from the saved value. Unrelated keys do not wait under an I/O lock.
design.deadline: A waiter uses remaining_management_read_budget; at capacity an unrelated key reads directly without growing the in-flight map. No timeout or budget changes.
design.freshness: Successful Registry summary pages may be up to 5 seconds old. Hits do not extend TTL. Persona and ranking reads still use the existing request-scoped flow.
design.composition: Follows sibling PR #7362 single-flight/memo pattern at the strategy owner-page layer; preserves existing strategy route parallel prefetch and leaves personas and artifact paging untouched.

hosted_before_reference.profile_summary: The existing hosted pre-change cProfile measured strategy owner page 0.5394 seconds, with http_request_json 0.5371 seconds (urlopen 0.4683 seconds). This supports deduplicating repeated validated owner reads. It is a single-owner profile; hosted fan-out p95 was 3.2318 seconds.
hosted_before_reference.attribution_limit: The hosted concurrent regression indicates contention beyond the isolated owner wait; no new hosted after-change claim is made by this fixture benchmark.

benchmark_method.statistics: Nearest-rank p50/p95 and max. Every round awaits and consumes all nine response bodies. First cold round is included, with a fresh app/port in each mode; no warmup round is discarded.
benchmark_method.transport: httpx ASGITransport, real production routers mounted by build_consolidated_cross_cutting_app, real RegistryService/RegistryStore summary-page projection. Owner HTTP boundary is replaced by the real Registry fixture plus time.sleep(0.54).
benchmark_method.baseline: The benchmark compiles the immutable original port from git show at source_base_commit; all other route, fixture, latency, auth and concurrency code is identical between modes.
benchmark_method.profile: cProfile covers the isolated owner read and each actual uncached read inside the strategy worker during nine-read fan-out, with both before and after profiles recorded below. Before change, wait plus Registry summary/index projection dominate; memo avoids repeating that work on subsequent page loads.
benchmark_method.limitations: The eight sibling routes use in-memory empty owner datasets. Strategy fixture matches requested hosted counts, but the fixture does not reproduce all hosted owner workloads, network hops, or single-process uvicorn contention. The baseline is already under 2 seconds here; these numbers establish fixture acceptance and repeated-read savings, not hosted after-change latency. No deploy was performed.
benchmark_method.execution: Final before and after benchmarks ran sequentially in one bounded timeout 180 batch, with no concurrent local test batch. Both exited 0; the batch exited 0 and all terminal output was collected.
